segments.oily: A few reviewers with oily skin note the balm can feel heavy or greasy if too much is applied, though it is not described as greasy in normal use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the balm relieves cracked lips, rough patches, elbows, cuticles and winter dryness, calling it soothing and non-stripping.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin says the balm worked well for her and left skin feeling refreshed rather than heavy.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin describe the balm as fragrance-free or lightly scented, soothing, and non-irritating.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes it as suited to "normal skin girlies," finding it refreshing with no issues.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report strong relief from dryness — cracked lips, rough patches, elbows, cuticles, and winter dryness — describing skin as soft, nourished and hydrated after use; a couple note it feels too heavy to fully use as a face moisturizer.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers say it cleanses or removes makeup without the stripped feeling other cleansers cause, describing it as gentle and non-irritating even on reactive skin.
concerns.blemishes: Two reviewers report the balm caused breakouts when used as a facial cleanser or moisturizer, while the majority of other users report no such issue.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers note that applying too much leaves oily skin feeling heavy or overly shiny, contrasting with most reviewers who find it non-greasy.

aspects.libelle: Unclear performance as a makeup-removing cleanser

extraits.texte: I received this product complimentary from lagirl in exchange for my honest review. I'm really confused by this product. It's touted as a multi use balm and cleanser, but I do not find it removes makeup very well (with or without water). I've used other waterless cleansing balms and had great results so this one for some reason just didn't work for me. It is a rich, thicker balm and fine for use on the lips, but I'm not sure I would purchase it solely for that reason. I'll use it up but it won't be a repurchase for me since it couldn't even remove my mascara.

extraits.titre: Good for lipstick and dry patches.
extraits.texte: complimentary from lagirl I found this to be a good balm for my lips. It's very hydrating and quickly takes care of any dryness. I tried using it for cleansing I do a double cleanse every morning and night so I tried using this first. It did help remove makeup, but it did break me out. I would use this on lips or any really rough patches.

Received it 7 days ago and it is already gone. I used it everyday, if felt great and absorbed eventually. My skin is definitely more moisturized. Too heavy for a face moisturizer, made me break out. But its nice to keep in my bag to moisturize cuticles and itchy dry spots. No scent, which is good. complimentary from L.A. Girl

This little tube has become a must have for me. If you have dry skin patches like I do, you need this in your life. I have been using the Pro Multi-tasker Balm on my dry spots and lips, and the hydration is unreal. My skin can be pretty sensitive, but this is incredibly soothing and doesn't irritate it at all. I also love that it's the perfect size to throw in your purse on the go. This was gifted by L.A. Girl.

extraits.titre: Great for lips and dry hands
extraits.texte: I really enjoyed this! It's great for the normal skin girlies. I have combo skin and thought that it worked for me . I found it refreshing after every use. I love how it melts away makeup gently without stripping my skin, while still giving that smooth, soothed glow. It truly feels like skincare and self-care in one product. complimentary from lagirl

I love that this balm is a cleanser and hydrator. I have dry skin and I like that it soothes and softens my skin. The texture absorbs fast. It is able to remove my makeup gently. I use it on my body, face, and lips. This was complimentary from L.A. Girl.

Complimentary from lagirl :) This product was so great for my skin. I have dry skin and sometimes when I put on makeup the makeup settles into my dry patches. Since I started using this that hasn't happened and my skin feels nourished and looks great!
